{{Quote|The Minister of Logistics is making sure the war effort is well supplied.|Freedmar informs a customer on supplying efforts|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Freedmar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], who was also known by the nickname '''"Flex"''', and served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|red]] and gold colored [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and worked selling equipment to other Imperial during the war. He worked in the supplies section on board the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], which was located within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Freedmar was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as an Imperial classic gear vendor within the Imperial fleet. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
